home.subtitle: Secure and efficient AI API aggregation and management platform
home.feature_gateway_desc: Single entry point for multiple AI platforms with unified API format and seamless provider switching.
home.feature_security_desc: API key management, IP whitelisting/blacklisting, and quota limits for comprehensive API security.
home.feature_channels_desc: Configure upstream channels centrally: multi-key rotation, priority scheduling, and automatic failover.
home.feature_analytics_desc: Real-time monitoring of requests, token usage, and costs with multi-dimensional data analysis.
home.feature_keys_desc: Multi-key group management with customizable quotas, expiration, and fine-grained access control.
home.feature_multi_platform_desc: Built-in support for OpenAI, Anthropic, and other major platforms, ready to use out of the box.

settings.asset_retention_section_hint: This section only controls the Studio task lifecycle. Expired terminal tasks and their related inputs/outputs are cleaned together; leave blank to use the default, 0 means keep forever.
settings.asset_retention_generated_days_hint: Studio generation tasks, generated images, and task inputs are cleaned together. Leave blank to use the default; set 0 to disable auto cleanup. Default is 7 days.
settings.openclaw_quickstart_desc: Pick the command for your OS. Both scripts generate openclaw.json (~/.openclaw/ on Unix, %USERPROFILE%\.openclaw\ on Windows) with interactive model selection.
settings.openclaw_base_url_missing_hint: Neither openclaw.base_url nor api_base_url is set; the preview uses the current browser URL. The script will fall back to the request Host at runtime, but setting it explicitly avoids misdetection behind reverse proxies.
settings.openclaw_enabled_desc: When disabled, the public /openclaw/* routes return 404 and users cannot install via the one-line command.
settings.openclaw_provider_name_hint: Key name written into openclaw.json. agents.defaults.model.primary will use <name>/<model>. Default: airgate.
settings.openclaw_base_url_hint: Leave blank to fall back to api_base_url, then to the request Host. /v1 is appended automatically when writing the config.
settings.openclaw_memory_search_enabled_desc: When enabled, the generated openclaw.json includes agents.defaults.memorySearch pointing at this site's embedding model.
settings.openclaw_memory_search_model_hint: Embedding model name openclaw uses for memory search. Must match a model id served by this site's /v1/models.
settings.openclaw_models_preset_desc: JSON array. Fields match openclaw.json provider.models[] exactly; the extra 'label' field is shown to users by the install script.
settings.openclaw_models_not_array: Preset must be a JSON array
